root_cause: Sense nets SENSEC2_HI and SENSEC2_LO have fragmented pours due to foreign signal crossings (foreign_cross=17 and 15 respectively), causing DRC violations and over-temp. Placement of foreign signals crossing the sense corridors is the root cause.
reasoning: The candidate fails with structural DRC=6 and unconnected nets=2. Pour-integrity shows clipped nets with islands and high foreign cross counts, indicating that foreign signals are cutting through the sense pours. This leads to narrow copper paths, causing over-temp FEM flags on these nets. The placement of these foreign signals relative to the sense corridors is the upstream issue; more routing effort alone cannot fix the fragmented pours.

proposed_lever.detail: Shift foreign signals (e.g., +3V3, /I2C_SDA, /THRESH) away from the SENSEC2_HI and SENSEC2_LO corridors, or use layer-stagger to route them on F.Cu/B.Cu layers that avoid cutting the sense pours. This will restore pour integrity and reduce DRC violations.
